Figures are drawn from the Insolvency Service monthly company insolvency statistics, Companies House register data and winding-up petitions advertised in The Gazette. England and Wales figures are seasonally adjusted where the Insolvency Service has identified seasonality. The latest month is provisional and can be revised.
